sin.name: long-inline-module-field
sin.description: A module field is a list or a declaration written over several lines in the module's class, so the module no longer reads as a list of names.
sin.rule: Give the value a name in a file of its own in the module's declarations folder, <module>_<field>.py, and set the field to that name: handlers = WORKERS_HANDLERS. A field of one short line stays inline.
